name: error-codes
description: Stable client-facing error codes. 'wirePrefix' is what Postgres functions raise today ('<prefix>: message', docs/backend-contract.md section 11, surfaced by PostgREST as code P0001, HTTP 400). Clients and gateways map prefix to code; codes never change once released. Additive only. Since migrations 20261006000013-19 (2026-10-06): 'http' is the status a client/gateway maps the prefix to; PostgREST itself answers every RAISE with HTTP 400 / code P0001.

error.message: English, safe to log; the UI localizes by code and never shows this verbatim.

codes.meaning: No session, expired session, or phone not OTP-confirmed.
Signed in but does not own the target row, or an admin-only action was attempted (SQL reuses this prefix for admin-only failures).
Target does not exist or is not publicly visible. get_public_profile returns JSON null with HTTP 200 today; the client adapter translates null to NOT_FOUND.

Bad, missing, oversized or wrongly typed field; also unknown category/locality and search bounds (text > 80 chars, > 20 filters, offset > 500). All owner RPCs use this prefix (0012's bare 'validation:' was replaced in 0017).
Publish gate failed: phone display consent missing. Other publish failures use validation_failed / location_not_active / not_authenticated / suspended.
Enabling WhatsApp while phone display consent is off (record_consent / update_profile_full).
City launch_status is not active: enforced in register_profile and at publish time; inactive markets are also hidden from every discovery path.
Not raised: unknown categories raise validation_failed; un-approved categories are accepted on a draft but cannot publish and are never shown publicly (is_publicly_listed).
Listing or account is suspended by moderation.
Uniqueness or state conflict: account already has a profile; stale expectedRevision ('conflict: revision_mismatch'); idempotency key reused with a different payload.

codes.wirePrefix: conflict: this phone number already owns a profile
codes.meaning: A specific CONFLICT message; Dart throws a distinct exception type. Propose a dedicated wire prefix 'duplicate_phone'.

submit_report (5/hour, 20/day per source; 50/day per listing for anonymous and, separately, signed-in reporters), request_city (5/day per source), record_consent and record_terms_acceptance (60/hour per listing, 0021), set_map_location (30/hour, 0022), credential claims (10/day per user, 0022). record_engagement never raises: over-budget events are dropped silently. Source = signed-in user id or daily-rotating hash of the edge client IP; report de-duplication also checks the previous day's hash.

The capability is switched off by a server feature flag (0022): media_intake, credential_intake, precise_location, provider_signup. The UI should already hide it via get_client_flags; this is the boundary.

codes.wirePrefix: (any unmapped error, e.g. Postgres 22P02 invalid input syntax)
codes.meaning: Unmapped Postgres or Edge error. Owner write RPCs now map type errors and unknown references to validation_failed; anything else is a bug to report.
